fields.Name: T119 - AI Configuration
fields.Description: Verifies the Configuration section of the AI app renders its settings view without errors.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the AI application using the application switcher dropdown next to the logo (NOT the Ctrl+K search box), then open the Configuration section. Confirm the configuration/settings view renders. This is a platform view that may have sparse data in a fresh regression DB, so accept its expected widgets or an empty-state as long as the view renders. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment, so wait for content rather than navigating away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The AI app Configuration section is displayed
The view shows configuration/settings content or a clear empty-state
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
